title: Searchable reference catalogue
story: A parts catalogue with server-side search, paging and a session cart.

durability.basis: transcribed from the pilot archetype and hand-reviewed; test/spec.test.mjs keeps the two in step

state.lifetime: per process, in a file named on the command line - not a durable store

tables.name: records
tables.purpose: the value a write stores, read back by the reference the server issued

tables.name: sessions
tables.purpose: who the server decided the requester is, for this session only

persistence.reference: session id issued by the server as a cookie
persistence.reload_assertion: reloading /cart still shows the cart the session stored; the query echo is a reflected URL parameter, not stored state

routes.effect: render the catalogue page with the search form and the cart form
read q from the query string, search the records, and render the results with q reflected in the page
store the part number against the session and redirect back to the cart
read the session and render what it stores

validation.on_missing: a search with no query renders an empty result set rather than refusing
validation.on_success: a cart post stores the part number against the session and redirects to /cart

acceptance: the echoed query is the value this attempt typed, reflected by the server after a GET reload
the cart write is read back from the session, and the part number posted is unique to this attempt so an older row cannot satisfy it
an optional field is not made required by the uplift: the project never asked the user for it
